metadata.title: Likelihood-Ranked Selection in Self-Consuming Diffusion: A W2 Negative Result and a Narrow Minority-Retention Regime
metadata.description:
Workshop-scale empirical note. Primary: top-k likelihood selection does not improve sliced W2 vs random-k at generation 1 (23/23 cells; bootstrap CI excludes zero). Secondary: full bottom>rand>top minority retention only in a narrow regime at ρ=5 (n=10, 10/10; exact Wilcoxon p=0.002), failing for most seeds at ρ=7 and ρ=10. Not shown on ImageNet-scale diffusion.

Code: https://github.com/muhammadalamzeb/likelihood-rank-self-consuming-diffusion
metadata.notes: Workshop-scope empirical note. Primary claim: top-k does not improve sliced W2 (n=23 cells). Secondary: narrow minority-retention regime at rho=5 (n=10; exact Wilcoxon p=0.002). Not ImageNet-scale.
